subject: Packaging options & safe rollback for Clearline pilot expansion
messages:
From: Samira Patel <samira@clearlinedx.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@clearlinedx.com
Date: Sun, 13 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Packaging options for expansion pilot (follow-up)

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for yesterday's demo — our clinical team was impressed with inference latency and the private deployment controls. We're planning to expand the pilot from 2 to 6 clinics across two regions. Before we commit, procurement needs a clear matrix:

- Recommended plan for a mid-sized pilot (6 sites, average 4000 requests/day)
- Upgrade path to production (throughput tiers, burst credits)
- Downgrade/rollback protections and how credits/proration would work if we scale down after Q1
- Any bulk discounts for a 12-month commitment and what triggers apply

Can you send a short matrix and a ballpark on pricing and discounts? I've attached our draft SOW and a PO template.

—Samira

Attachments: Clearline_SOW_v1.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Samira Patel <samira@clearlinedx.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 08:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Packaging options for expansion pilot (follow-up)

Hi Samira — great to hear the team liked the demo. High level answers below; I'll follow up with a one-pager matrix and a pricing workbook by EOD.

1) Recommended pilot plan: Compact+Burst bundle — gives you a baseline throughput tier that covers 6 sites with a 30% burst buffer.
2) Upgrade path: You can pin to a throughputs tier or move to Dedicated capacity. Upgrades are immediate with capacity confirmation; cost is pro-rated daily from the date of upgrade.
3) Downgrade/rollback: We support a 14-day ‘rollback’ window after a plan change where we can revert to the prior pinned tier without penalty. Long-term downgrades result in pro-rata refunds in credits for unused reserved capacity (applies to Dedicated/committed buys).
4) Discounts: For a 12-month committed contract we typically offer 10–18% depending on committed token/throughput volume. For pilots that convert to a committed plan within 60 days, we can provide an additional one-time onboarding credit.

I'll attach the pricing workbook (with three scenarios: conservative / expected / high) and a simple comparison matrix. Ben — can you confirm the discount windows and any standard enterprise clause language? Lauren — any notes on SLA exceptions for pilot burst?

Thanks,
Mina

Attachments: Pricing_Workbook_v2.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Samira Patel <samira@clearlinedx.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Packaging options for expansion pilot (follow-up)

Thanks — quick clarifications from pricing:

- Discount banding: 12-month commit = 12% baseline for the Compact+Burst volume Samira mentioned. If they commit to a Dedicated reserved pool (min 6-month commit), the discount increases to 18% + a 1-month onboarding credit.
- Trigger for onboarding credit: PO reception and signed MSA within 60 days of pilot expansion.
- Downgrade credits: For Dedicated reserved buys we issue unused capacity as account credits; for metered Hosted plans we prorate usage and refund unused prepaid portions only when a prepayment was used.

Samira — if Clearline prefers a ‘soft-commit’ route, we can propose a 6-month ramp with a middle-tier guaranteed throughput and an escape hatch at month 4 with limited credit exposure (we cap the customer liability to 50% of remaining committed spend in that scenario).

Ben

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Samira Patel <samira@clearlinedx.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Packaging options for expansion pilot (follow-up)

Hi Samira — operational notes on rollback & feature bundling:

- Feature bundling: The Compact+Burst includes prefix caching and KV cache retention by default; Dedicated adds prioritized scheduling and region pinning. If you need the region isolation across two regions, we recommend Dedicated or a hybrid (hosted + edge pools).
- Rollback mechanics: Our 14-day rollback covers configuration and tier changes only. Data export, model pin changes, or custom integrations are outside the rollback and will need separate change management.
- Add-on toggles: We can gate advanced safety filters and tracing as add-ons that can be enabled/disabled without a plan change for the pilot (useful for phased rollout).

If you send the PO, procurement and legal can loop us into the MSA review. I can draft the simple amendment language to preserve the rollback window for the initial 60 days post-signature.

—Lauren

From: Samira Patel <samira@clearlinedx.com>

Next steps from our side: we'll submit a PO (attached) that references the Compact+Burst pilot with the optional Dedicated conversion clause and the rollback amendment. Once you confirm the language for the amendment and the PO matches, we'll send the signed PO.

Please confirm you can accept the attached PO template and we'll proceed.
